description.value: Tartine Bread & Pies is a neighbourhood bakery established in 2002, situated just off English Bay on Beach Avenue in Vancouver. Founded by Jo-Ann and grown from a home kitchen, it serves freshly baked pies, quiches, muffins, breads, and pastries alongside soups, salads, and breakfast and lunch sandwiches. The bakery uses premium natural ingredients with no artificial preservatives and offers both indoor and outdoor seating.
